items.q: How does the free trial work?
items.a: 14 days fully free, all features included. No credit card required. You pick a plan during onboarding but only pay after 14 days. You can upgrade to a paid plan at any time.
After 14 days you'll be asked to choose a plan. Until then your account remains active but new features are blocked. Your data stays safe and you can upgrade whenever you want.
On signup you'll go through a 7-step wizard: shop name, plan selection, company details, logo upload, first product, payments and launch. You can skip steps and complete them later in your settings.

items.q: What is the Shop Health Score?
items.a: A real-time score (0-100%) measuring your shop's health across 6 areas: fulfillment, inventory, customer service, finance, SEO and compliance. You get personalized daily tips to improve it.
Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade at any time via Settings → Subscription. Upgrades are instant, downgrades take effect next billing period. No hidden fees.
Dutch, English, French and German. Both the admin interface and your webshop are fully translatable. AI translations are available for product descriptions and marketing content.

items.q: Can I migrate my existing webshop?
items.a: Yes! We have import tools for Shopify, WooCommerce and other platforms. Enterprise customers get free migration help worth €2,000.
Via Stripe Connect you support iDEAL, Bancontact, credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay and 40+ other methods. Your customers pay directly into your Stripe account.
Absolutely! We support VAT-exempt transactions, net pricing, customer-specific prices and automatic Peppol e-invoicing for business customers (coming soon).
AI credits are used to generate content like social posts, emails and product descriptions. Pro gets 500/month, Enterprise 5,000/month. Extra credits can be bought for €19 per 500 credits.

items.q: Can I sell in-store with SellQo?
items.a: Yes! Our POS module is a full register with touch interface, barcode scanner, gift card sales and Stripe Terminal. Available as add-on for €29/month or €15/month on Pro.

items.q: Which promotions can I set up?
items.a: SellQo supports 8 promotion types: discount codes, volume discounts, BOGO (buy one get one), product bundles, customer groups with special prices, automatic discounts, gift cards and a complete loyalty program with points.

items.q: How do I build my own webshop?
items.a: With the built-in Webshop Builder you pick a theme, customize sections via drag & drop and connect your own domain. Starter gets basic themes, Pro gets 1 premium theme, Enterprise gets all.

items.q: Are there extra costs on top of the subscription?
items.a: No. You only pay the standard Stripe payment fees (1.5% + €0.25 per transaction). We charge no extra transaction fees. Add-ons like POS are optional.

items.q: What is Peppol and why does it matter?
items.a: From 2026 electronic invoicing via Peppol is mandatory for all B2B transactions in Belgium. Our Peppol integration is in development and will launch before the deadline so you're compliant in time.

items.q: What happens to my data if I cancel?
items.a: Your data stays yours. You can export everything (products, customers, orders) in CSV, Excel or via API. We only delete your data 30 days after cancellation.
